abstract: Combines SAM segmentation with neural matching to solve zero-shot 6D object pose estimation from RGB-D inputs without target CAD models.

title: Adaptive Grasp Pose Optimization for Robotic Arms Using Low-Cost RGB-D Sensors
abstract: Implements noise filtering and surface curvature analysis on low-cost RGB-D depth feeds to optimize grasp pose selection.

title: Application of Cloud Simulation Techniques for Robotic Software Validation Middleware & Sensors
authors: Diogo Vieira, Miguel Martins, et al.
abstract: Presents a cloud-native CI/CD simulation testbed executing headless Gazebo and ROS 2 test suites for software regression validation.

title: Time and Frequency Domain Analysis of IMU-Based Orientation Estimation Algorithms with Comparison to Robotic Manipulators Middleware & Sensors
abstract: Benchmarks Madgwick, Mahony, and Extended Kalman Filters against high-accuracy robotic arm optical ground truth for joint angle estimation.

title: Deformable and Fragile Object Manipulation: A Review and Prospects
abstract: Surveys tactile sensing arrays, compliance control, and finite-element modeling for handling delicate agricultural and food produce.

title: Singularity Avoidance in Inverse Kinematics: A Unified Treatment of Classical and Learning-Based Methods
abstract: Unifies damped least squares, manipulability gradient projection, and neural barrier certificates to prevent arm singularities.

title: Optimizing Small Language Models for In-Vehicle Function-Calling LLMs & Planning
abstract: Quantizes and fine-tunes 1B-3B parameter SLMs for ultra-fast deterministic JSON function execution in resource-constrained hardware.

title: SMART-LLM: Smart Multi-Agent Robot Task Planning using Large Language Models LLMs & Planning
abstract: Decomposes complex human instructions into multi-agent subtasks and optimizes task allocation across diverse robots.

title: Learning Manipulation Skills through Robot Chain-of-Thought with Sparse Failure Guidance
abstract: Utilizes sparse failure labels during policy execution to refine intermediate reasoning tokens in embodied chain-of-thought models.

title: 3D Gaussian Splatting in Robotics: A Survey
authors: Siting Zhu, Guangming Wang, Xinjie Wang, Hesheng Wang (Shanghai Jiao Tong University)
venue: arXiv preprint arXiv:2410.12262 • 3D Vision, Gaussian Splatting & Spatial Representations
abstract: First comprehensive survey on 3D Gaussian Splatting applications in robotics: SLAM, dynamic tracking, simulation, and manipulation.

title: SpringGrasp: Synthesizing Compliant, Dexterous Grasps under Shape Uncertainty
authors: Sirui Chen, Jeannette Bohg, C. Karen Liu (Stanford University)
abstract: Models virtual compliance springs at finger contact points to guarantee stable dexterous grasps under severe object shape uncertainty.

title: Tactile-Conditioned Diffusion Policy for Force-Aware Robotic Manipulation
abstract: Conditions diffusion action policies on continuous high-density tactile sensor arrays for delicate insertion and contact-rich assembly.

title: Talk-to-Resolve: Combining Scene Understanding and Spatial Dialogue to Resolve Ambiguities LLMs & Planning
abstract: Couples 3D object detection with multimodal dialogue generation to resolve referring expressions in complex tabletop scenes.

title: Improving Reproducibility in Machine Learning: Overview, Barriers, and Drivers Middleware & Sensors
abstract: Analyzes reproducibility barriers across deep learning pipelines and presents protocols for deterministic robotic model validation.

title: ThinkGrasp: A Vision-Language System for Strategic Part Grasping in Clutter
authors: Yaoyao Qian, Xupeng Zhu, Ondrej Biza, et al.
abstract: Combines VLM spatial reasoning with geometric grasping networks to strategize part-level grasping in heavily stacked clutter.

title: TinyAgent: Function Calling at the Edge LLMs & Planning
authors: Lutfi Eren Erdogan, Nicholas Lee, Siddharth Jha, Sehoon Kim, Ryan Tabrizi, et al. (UC Berkeley)
abstract: Demonstrates high-accuracy function calling on tiny 1B-3B parameter edge models outperforming larger models via specialized tool tuning.

title: TransCG: A Large-Scale Real-World Dataset for Transparent Object Grasping and Depth Estimation
authors: Hongjie Fang, Hao-Shu Fang, Sheng Xu, Cewu Lu (Shanghai Jiao Tong University)
venue: IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L) / arXiv:2202.08471 • 3D Vision, Gaussian Splatting & Spatial Representations
abstract: Releases a comprehensive real-world transparent object dataset featuring 51,000 paired RGB-D images and 6DOF grasp ground truth.

title: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models LLMs & Planning
authors: Shunyu Yao, Dian Yu, Jeffrey Zhao, Izhak Shafran, Thomas L. Griffiths, Yuan Cao, Karthik Narasimhan (Princeton & Google DeepMind)
abstract: Introduces Tree of Thoughts (ToT), enabling language models to explore multiple reasoning paths, evaluate choices, and backtrack.

title: Uncertainty Comes for Free: Human-in-the-Loop Policies with Diffusion Models
abstract: Extracts ensemble variance and score entropy directly from diffusion policy denoising trajectories to trigger timely human intervention.

title: Towards a Unified Understanding of Robot Manipulation: A Comprehensive Survey
abstract: Presents a unified taxonomy linking perception, affordances, trajectory generation, tactile feedback, and foundation policy learning.

title: Visual Dexterity: In-Hand Reorientation of Novel and Complex Object Shapes
authors: Tao Chen, Megha Tippur, Siyang Qin, Edward Adelson, Pulkit Agrawal (MIT)
abstract: Demonstrates arbitrary in-hand reorientation of complex geometric objects using vision and proprioception on an anthropomorphic hand.

title: Wide-Range and Real-Time 3D Tracking of a Moving Object by Dynamic Vision Sensor
authors: Journal of Robotics and Mechatronics Authors
abstract: Employs neuromorphic Dynamic Vision Sensors (event cameras) for ultra-low latency wide-range 3D tracking of high-speed moving targets.
